observations.why: The adoption act carries a move toward a new tool, but no broader value pattern is named.
The quantified performance claim appeals directly to capability and technical mastery.
A scheduled migration timeline presents change as orderly and bounded rather than open-ended.
The presented database choice carries a move toward a new solution; the split footing reports the principal's stance.
The performance framing appeals directly to increased capability and quality of execution.
The explicit start quarter frames the change through predictable scheduling and stability.
